beats.en: Yoga is a physical, mental and spiritual practice that started in ancient India. The word yoga comes from the Sanskrit root yuj, which means to join or to unite.

textbookBox.concept: Asanas, or postures, stretch and strengthen muscles and improve flexibility, endurance and balance. This improves overall fitness and can reduce body pain such as lower back pain.

beats.en: On 20 June 2021 the World Health Organisation launched an app called WHO mYoga, with videos and audio files to teach and support yoga practice. The aim was an easy-to-use, free tool for people everywhere.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · Yoga—A Way of Life · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: We can start yoga at any moment. When we practise asanas we do not only stretch the body, since the mind has to be with the body too. So it should be done without distractions.
